---
name: Bug report
about: An existing skill is producing wrong, incomplete, or misleading output.
title: '[bug] '
labels: bug
assignees: MacroTechTitan
---

## Skill

Which skill? (e.g., `maximus-chain-of-verification`)

## Model

Which model did you run it on? (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Perplexity, local — be
specific about the version if you know it.)

## What went wrong

A clear description of the bad output or unexpected behavior.

## Input that produced it

Paste the input, prompt, or file (with any sensitive data redacted) that
triggered the bug. Small reproducers are easier to fix.

## What you expected

What should the skill have produced instead?

## Anything else

Version of the skill file if you have it, date you ran it, any additional
context.
